build_process_group_stats_monitor: build a ProcessGroupStatsMonitor subprocess to collect CPU memory and disk IO stats per process group
create_process_group_resource_usage: create a ProcessGroupResourceUsage dataclass to snapshot CPU percent RSS PSS private bytes and disk IO
parse_proc_stat: parse /proc/[pid]/stat to extract process group ID utime stime and RSS in pages
parse_smaps_rollup: parse /proc/[pid]/smaps_rollup to extract PSS private clean and private dirty memory in bytes
read_network_bytes: read /proc/net/dev to aggregate network RX and TX bytes across all non-loopback interfaces
